q1.question: Is MUEDear really free?
q1.answer: Yes! You get 5 free games every day, with access to all game modes. You can optionally watch rewarded ads to play more. There are no locked features or required purchases.

q2.question: What makes MUEDear different from other ear training apps?
q2.answer: Custom DSP algorithms. Most ear training apps use pre-recorded audio samples. MUEDear's MuComp processes audio in real-time using custom DSP modeled after legendary studio gear characteristics.

q3.question: Do I need music production experience?
q3.answer: MUEDear is designed for all skill levels. Beginners will learn to identify fundamental frequency bands and compression characteristics. Experienced producers will sharpen their speed and accuracy.

q4.question: How long should I train each day?
q4.answer: Our free tier gives you 5 games per day — about 15-20 minutes of training. This is enough to make steady progress without taking time away from actual music production.

q5.question: Why limit how much I can play?
q5.answer: We believe ear training should enhance your music production, not replace it. The daily limit encourages you to apply what you've learned in your actual projects.

q6.question: Will there be a premium subscription?
q6.answer: We're considering a premium tier with unlimited plays and detailed analytics for future versions. The free tier will always remain fully functional.

q7.question: What languages are supported?
q7.answer: Currently English and Japanese. More languages coming soon.

q8.question: Is my progress saved?
q8.answer: Yes, your high scores and settings are saved locally on your device.

q1.question: Voice recognition isn't working
q1.answer: Please check that microphone access is enabled. You can verify MUEDnote's microphone permission in your device's Settings app.

q2.question: Sessions aren't being saved
q2.answer: Please check your internet connection. Data is temporarily stored when offline and synced when connection is restored. If the problem persists, try restarting the app.

q3.question: Voice memo transcription is inaccurate
q3.answer: Transcription accuracy depends on recording conditions. Try to speak clearly in a quiet environment. Technical terms and proper nouns may be difficult to recognize.

q4.question: Break reminders aren't working
q4.answer: Please check that notifications are enabled. Note that Do Not Disturb mode may suppress notifications.

q5.question: I can't log in
q5.answer: Please verify your email address is correct. If you've forgotten your password, tap "Forgot password" on the login screen to reset it.

q6.question: I want to delete my data
q6.answer: If you wish to delete your account, please contact support. Please note that deleted data cannot be recovered.

q7.question: Can I use it offline?
q7.answer: Basic features (timer, break reminders) work offline. Internet connection is required for voice memo transcription and syncing.

q8.question: What devices and OS versions are supported?
q8.answer: MUEDnote supports iPhone running iOS 17.0 or later. iPad is not currently supported.

q9.question: I bought masterchain. Where is my license key?
q9.answer: Sign in to the mued.jp portal (mued.jp/dashboard/plugins) with the same email address you used at checkout — your key is there, with Copy key and Download license.key. If you used a different address at checkout or cannot sign in, contact support@mued.jp with your order number and we will help. To install the key, drag license.key onto masterchain (if drop doesn't work in your DAW, use "Load license file…" or "Paste license key").

q10.question: Can I try it before I buy?
q10.answer: Yes. Without a key, masterchain runs as a demo with no time limit. In the demo it processes the first 45 seconds of audio after you insert it, then passes audio through unprocessed until you reinsert it. Settings aren't saved and presets can't be saved. Entering a license key removes these limits.

q11.question: At the end of the installation, macOS said the installer “can’t be moved to the Trash”
q11.answer: The installation is complete. The message means the macOS Installer could not move the used installer (.pkg) to the Trash. Please move the .pkg to the Trash yourself in Finder.

meta.title: MUEDsp drive (aka MUEDrive) — a free saturator with three characters
meta.description: MUEDsp drive (aka MUEDrive) is a free saturator with three characters — tube, warm and console — in one plugin. Put it on a bus, push DRIVE, and listen. macOS (Universal), VST3 · AU · AAX. Nothing locked, nothing paywalled.

hero.title: MUEDrive
hero.lead: tube, warm, console. Switch between three characters and mix through it. Free.
hero.tryLine: Free. Just grab it and try it on your own music.

about.heading: What it is
about.originLead: Not a demo or a trial — it's the third free plugin I've put out under MUED. Unlike the first two, though, it isn't a stage lifted out of MUEDsp masterchain, my mastering chain; it's a standalone plugin I started outside the chain. Where MUEDsat adds sheen up top, this one is about what happens when you push the middle and the low end. On a bus, a drum bus, or before your master: run it through, push DRIVE, and each character breaks up differently.
about.charactersLead: Switch with the selector. Same DRIVE, different break-up.

tube.name: tube
tube.desc: tube-like second harmonics. It swells when you hit it, and settles when you let go.

warm.name: warm
warm.desc: even harmonics dominate and the upper ones fall away quickly. The gentlest of the three. I like it blended in under a bass.

console.name: console
console.desc: the hardness of pushing into a desk. It pushes forward.

about.controlsLead: DRIVE for how much, FOCUS for where it starts. Then MIX and OUTPUT.

focus.name: FOCUS
focus.desc: the line above which it distorts; below it passes through. The readout shows the actual value for the character you've selected, so it changes when you switch.

bypass.name: BYPASS
bypass.desc: a true bypass, for honest A/B.
